title: 第一章 休书第二章 第一桶金
lines: 沈南枝睁开眼，嘴里全是血腥味。
她明明死了——趴在出租屋的桌子上，胸口疼得吸不进最后一口气。可这会儿太阳毒辣辣地砸在脸上，苍蝇在耳边嗡嗡叫，脚下的泥地被踩得稀烂，烂菜叶子混着鸡蛋壳的臭味直往鼻子里钻。
有人推了她一把。
“沈南枝！装什么死？休书你接不接？”
她猛地抬头。
晒谷场上围满了人。灰扑扑的衣裳，嗑瓜子的嘴，看猴戏的眼神。一个穿蓝布衫的女人尖着嗓子：“哎哟，被休回娘家，她还有脸活？”
另一个接话：“陆沉舟那样的老实人都忍不了她，可见她多过分。”
“听说她还偷白老师的东西？”
“可不是嘛，白老师多好的人……”
白老师。
沈南枝脑子里“嗡”的一声。那些乱糟糟的画面瞬间拼凑完整了——她穿进了那本她死前刚看完的年代虐文《港城往事》。
书里，女主白若溪温柔善良，历经磨难，最终和港城商业大佬陆沉舟终成眷属。而她现在的身份，是那个又蠢又坏的反派女配，也叫沈南枝。
书里这个角色的结局是什么来着？
被丈夫休弃，净身出户，带着女儿到处流浪，最后病死在出租屋里。死了三天没人发现，是邻居闻到臭味才报的警。
书里只写了一句话：“沈南枝这种人，死了也是活该。”
她当时看到这句还觉得解气。
现在她就是那个“活该”的人。
“看清楚了吗？”一个低沉的男声响起来。
沈南枝抬起头。
面前站着的男人一米八几，灰布短袖卷到肩膀上，露出结实的小臂。脸冷硬，浓眉深眼窝，下颌线像刀裁的——陆沉舟，原书男主角，也是她现在这具身体的丈夫。
他右手捏着一张纸，左手背在身后，腰板笔直。
休书。
原剧情里，这个时候她会扑上去又哭又闹，撕了休书，冲上去打白若溪，骂她是狐狸精，最后被全村人唾弃，灰溜溜滚回娘家。
沈南枝没动。
脑子里两秒钟转过无数念头：她现在的处境是被休、身无分文、带一个五岁女儿、所有人等着看笑话。原书的剧情会把她推向死亡。她必须从这里开始，每一步都走对。
不能闹。闹了就是给人当猴看。
这婚一定要离——离了才能跳出原书的剧情线。
还要让所有人以为她只是“被休后受了刺激变了个人”。
想清楚了。
她伸手，把休书接了过来。
晒谷场上一片哗然。
“她接了？怎么不闹啊？”
“是不是傻掉了？你看她那个眼神，怪瘆人的。”
沈南枝低头看休书。毛笔字端正，无非是“七出之条”“合离两宽”。她看了两秒，把休书叠好，塞进口袋。
然后抬头，看向陆沉舟身后。
白若溪穿着一件碎花裙子，两条辫子，脸蛋白净，大眼睛水汪汪的，正用手帕擦眼泪。那眼泪掉得恰到好处，不多不少，刚好让所有人都心疼。
她一边擦一边说：“南枝，你别怪沉舟哥，他也是没办法……你要是有什么难处，跟我说，我一定帮你。”
声音软得像棉花。
沈南枝笑了。
content_en:
Shen Nanzhi opened his eyes, and his mouth was filled with the smell of blood.
She was obviously dead - lying on the table in the rental house, her chest hurt so much that she couldn't take her last breath. But now the sun was hitting my face fiercely, flies were buzzing in my ears, the mud under my feet was trampled to pieces, and the smell of rotten vegetable leaves mixed with egg shells penetrated my nose.
Someone pushed her.
"Shen Nanzhi! Why are you pretending to be dead? Will you accept the divorce letter?"
She looked up sharply.
The grain drying field was crowded with people. The clothes are dusty, the mouth is eating melon seeds, and the eyes are watching the monkey show. A woman in a blue shirt said in a high-pitched voice: "Oh, she is divorced and returned to her parents' home. How can she still live?"
Another one answered: "An honest person like Lu Chenzhou can't stand her, which shows that she goes too far."
"I heard that she also stole Teacher Bai's things?"
"Isn't that right? Teacher Bai is such a good person..."
Teacher Bai.
Shen Nanzhi's mind buzzed. Those messy pictures were pieced together in an instant - she entered the period-era sadistic novel "Once Upon a Time in Hong Kong" that she had just read before her death.
In the book, the heroine Bai Ruoxi is gentle and kind-hearted. After going through many hardships, she finally gets married to Lu Chenzhou, a business tycoon in Hong Kong. And her current identity is that stupid and bad villain heroine, also named Shen Nanzhi.
What is the ending of this character in the book?
Abandoned by her husband, she left home and wandered around with her daughter, and finally died of illness in a rented house. No one found him dead for three days. It was a neighbor who smelled the stench and called the police.
There is only one sentence written in the book: "People like Shen Nanzhi deserve to die."
She felt relieved when she saw this sentence.
Now she's the one who "deserves it."
"Do you see clearly?" A deep male voice sounded.
Shen Nanzhi raised his head.
The man standing in front of him was about 1.8 meters tall. His gray cloth short sleeves were rolled up to his shoulders, revealing his strong forearms. With a cold and hard face, thick eyebrows and deep eye sockets, and a jawline cut like a knife - Lu Chenzhou, the male protagonist in the original book, is also the husband of her current body.
He is holding a piece of paper in his right hand, with his left hand behind his back and his back straight.
Letter of divorce.
In the original plot, at this time, she would pounce on Bai Ruoxi, cry and make a fuss, tear up the divorce letter, rush to beat Bai Ruoxi, call her a vixen, and finally be cast aside by the whole village, and return to her parents' home in despair.
Shen Nanzhi didn't move.
Countless thoughts ran through her mind in two seconds: Her current situation was that she was divorced, penniless, with a five-year-old daughter, and everyone was waiting to see the joke. The plot of the original book would push her to death. She had to start here and take every step right.
Can't make trouble. If you make trouble, you will be treated like a monkey.
This marriage must be divorced - divorce can break out of the plot line of the original book.
She also wants everyone to think that she just "changed after being stimulated after being divorced."
Think clearly.
She reached out and took the divorce letter.
There was an uproar on the grain drying field.
"She answered? Why didn't you make a fuss?"
"Are you stupid? The look in her eyes is so scary."
Shen Nanzhi lowered his head to read the divorce letter. The calligraphy of the calligraphy brush is straight and straight, which is nothing more than "seven outs" and "two widths for unity and separation". She looked at it for two seconds, folded the divorce letter, and stuffed it into her pocket.
Then he raised his head and looked behind Lu Chenzhou.
Bai Ruoxi was wearing a floral skirt with two braids. She had a clean face and big watery eyes, and she was wiping her tears with a handkerchief. The tears fell just right, not too much and not too little, just enough to make everyone feel sad.
While wiping, she said: "Nanzhi, don't blame Brother Shen Zhou, he can't help it... If you have any difficulties, just tell me and I will definitely help you."
The voice is as soft as cotton.
Shen Nanzhi smiled.
